en.title: Letters from Fog Harbor
en.subtitle: Restore a light. Deliver the words left unsent.
en.a1_line: Welcome to town! Come find me again in the evening.
en.a2_line: A coffee? Thank you for remembering what I like.
en.a3_line: I accept your invitation. Let us visit the garden tonight.
en.b1_line: Hello! I take care of the garden around the corner.
en.b2_line: You lit the garden lamp. It feels warm here again.
en.b3_line: I enjoy talking with you. Let us look after this garden together.
en.smalltalk: Good to see you! Check the next requirements or return at another time.

en.chapter: An independent story · signal station and dispatch
en.coffee_hello: You remembered my favorite coffee? The shop has been busy all day. I could use a break.
en.coffee_reply: I thought you might need a break. We can have it together when you are ready.
en.coffee_offer: Thank you. I have been hoping for a chance to talk with you, too.
en.coffee_after: This coffee is lovely. Next time, let me treat you.
en.coffee_end: It is a promise. I will remember it.
en.inspect_signal_line: The fog remains, but our signal has gone dark. Turn on backup power, buy a repair kit, and return this evening.
en.inspect_signal_reply: I will check the workshop and look for the old signal chart.
en.repair_relay_line: The power is stable. With that repair kit we can reconnect the relay.
en.repair_relay_reply: I will hold the cable. Then we can examine the old chart.
en.decode_chart_line: That gap is a calibration mark, left by the previous keeper. By the time we decode it, night has deepened.
en.decode_chart_reply: I know the position now. I will align the signal mirror next.
en.light_beacon_line: You aligned it. Look, a ship in the fog is answering! Thank you for staying.
en.light_beacon_reply: The harbor light is back. The waiting letters finally have a direction.
en.sort_letters_line: You found the manifest! Let us check the addresses now and prepare the last dispatch late tonight.
en.sort_letters_reply: I will read the names while you sort the letters.
en.last_dispatch_line: The addresses are checked and the final bag sealed. Once the signal returns, the boat can depart at dawn.
en.last_dispatch_reply: Then tomorrow can hold the departure. Let us remember what we did today.
en.ending_harbor: Fog Harbor reopens. Iris keeps the light, Mara sends the letters, and you leave with a promise to return.
en.world_blocked: An arriving character needs this tile. Move away and try again.
en.harbor_notice_text: Mara works at the mail desk by day and late at night. In the evening she walks along the quay. After the locker note is found, she spends evenings in the workshop.
en.harbor_locker_text: The key sticks in the lock. A note inside says: Sort the old letters in the workshop tonight.
en.harbor_note_text: Mara received the message. She will be at the workshop in the evening.
